description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseAPI class, which implements REST API endpoints for managing employee license data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee licenses, with integrated validation and OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseAPI
classes.description: API class for handling employee license records. Implements CRUD operations with validation and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicenseService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeLicenseService instance used for license data operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee license by employee number and license ID, returning structured API response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for 'getOne' operation, ensuring required parameters are valid.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all licenses for a specific employee, supporting pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' operation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee license record from request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a license.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Constructs and saves an EmployeeLicense entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns common validation rules for license creation and update requests.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee license with data from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an employee license.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee licenses based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Constructs a validation rule for employee number parameter.
